key_insight: CSPO adaptively calibrates sequence-level clipping bounds to target a specified marginal tail budget as the reasoning policy evolves.
engineering_relevance: Adaptive clipping aligns optimization with response-level rewards while accounting for changing score distributions during reinforcement learning.
method: Calibrate sequence-level clipping bounds using recent training statistics.
Bound out-of-band probability by target miscoverage plus CDF discrepancy and policy-drift terms.
Under additional moment conditions, bound objective and gradient error relative to the unclipped GSPO power surrogate.
evidence_signal: Experiments with the Qwen3-1.7B series report improvements over GSPO on difficult mathematical reasoning benchmarks and ALFWorld, with clipping endpoints adapting during training.
watch_item: The tail-budget guarantee is marginal; response-length-conditional calibration requires additional assumptions, and distribution drift contributes explicit error.
paper_title: Conformal Prediction-Enabled Sequence-level Policy Optimization for Reasoning Language Models
